_comment: Fixture stand-in for `terraform output -json` in aws/main + aws/bootstrap. Values are obviously-fake (account 000000000000) so nobody mistakes this for real infrastructure. Keys match the real output names used by scripts/aws/*.sh: s3_irsa_role_arn (scripts/aws/up-all.sh:127, from aws/main) and ecr_registry (scripts/aws/push-images.sh:33, from aws/bootstrap).
